source.title: Dumbbell Flat Bench Flyes: Form Guide, Muscles Worked & Programming

records.finding: Flat-bench supported isolation fly; feet planted, scapulae set, controlled wide arc and emphasized eccentric control through a large chest/shoulder stretch.
Beginner rear-delt fly using a stable hinged or chest-supported torso, soft elbows, controlled horizontal shoulder abduction and no torso swing.
Beginner-suitable bilateral overhead press from a seated back-supported position; bench stabilizes torso while arms press from shoulder height overhead.

source.title: How to Do Dumbbell Squat: Muscles Worked & Proper Form

records.finding: Shoulder-width bilateral dumbbell squat with light core brace and descent as deep as possible; source explicitly says it is easy to learn and suitable for beginners.
High-difficulty straight-arm straddle press to freestanding handstand requiring straight-arm shoulder strength, active compression, flexibility, balance and coordination without jumping.

source.title: Extended Plank: Form, Muscles Worked, Target Reps & Variations

records.finding: Intermediate bodyweight plank variation with arms farther forward, significantly increased instability and core engagement required to maintain rigid alignment.
Beginner standing EZ-bar curl: brace torso, keep upper arms mostly still, flex elbows through a comfortable range and lower under control without swinging.
Stable parallel stance at a high-pulley machine; sequential scapular retraction, shoulder horizontal abduction, elbow flexion and external rotation while maintaining fixed torso/head position.

source.title: Muscle up technique, step by step

records.finding: Muscle-up requires false grip, explosive pull to lower chest, aggressive transition and press to straight arms; readiness tests require 10 strict pull-ups, 10 full-depth dips and an explosive chest-height pull.

source.title: Finger-Assisted One Arm Pull Up Progressions

records.finding: Progression reduces assisting fingers from four to one; near-full bodyweight is borne by the working arm, strict 2-3 second eccentrics are required, and anti-rotation/core bracing demand rises as assistance falls.

source.title: Finger Pull Ups: Form Guide, Grip Progressions & Programming

records.finding: Advanced bodyweight pull-up performed with finger-only or reduced-finger contact, placing extreme stress on finger flexor tendons/pulleys and requiring controlled hanging and pulling.

source.title: Fingertip Push-Up: Proper Form, Muscles Worked, Benefits & Safety

records.finding: Advanced push-up variation supporting bodyweight on fingertips; develops finger strength, hand stability, wrist control and upper-body pushing strength under extended weight-bearing finger position.

Flat-back front lever is explicitly described as extremely difficult relative to tuck front lever: flattening the back lengthens the core and moves more bodyweight away from the hands, forcing greater back/core force while elbows stay straight and hips align with shoulders.
